title: The Last Weather Report
premise: A retired weather observer must choose between protecting her quiet routine and helping a neighbor save a community garden from a sudden frost.

chapters.title: The Cold Comes Early
beats: Ada closes her old weather station and notices a cloud pattern that suggests frost before morning, although the official forecast predicts a mild night.
Her neighbor Luis asks to borrow a ladder for the community garden. Ada nearly sends him away because the station equipment is being collected in the morning and she has not finished packing.
Ada realizes the late tomatoes and seedlings are at risk. She tells Luis about the frost, but he is skeptical because the official forecast says otherwise.
Ada chooses to bring out her packed thermometer and explain what she has observed. Luis agrees to help, and they improvise covers using materials already at the garden.
They finish after dark. Ada cannot know for certain whether the frost will arrive, but when Luis asks if she will check on the garden in the morning, she accepts.

characters.name: Ada
characters.arc: Moves from protecting her routine toward accepting a place in her community.

characters.name: Luis
characters.arc: Learns to consider Ada's local observations alongside the official forecast.

places.name: The weather station
places.description: A small station near a community garden, scheduled for closure.
